# American Physical Society citation style

`american-physics-society.csl` is an unmodified copy from the Citation Style
Language styles repository, retrieved on 2026-10-20:
https://github.com/citation-style-language/styles/blob/master/american-physics-society.csl

Authors: Richard Karnesky and Brenton M. Wiernik. Contributor: Anna C. Véron.
License: Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 3.0 Unported:
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/

Author, contributor, provenance, documentation and license metadata are retained
in the CSL file. This style provides citation and bibliography formatting; it
does not replace a journal's manuscript submission template.
